design: One independent ordinary frontier search and one independent expert frontier search; fresh contexts, same inherited model/configuration, same common packet and resource limits. Small exploratory comparison, not a statistical test of universal foresight.
ordinary_policy: Competent direct request: investigate the question, check primary sources, identify and rank three opportunities, explain one recommendation and a decisive experiment. Tools allowed to full common budget.
expert_policy: Explicit search method: distinguish needs from solutions, identify binding restrictions and underused resources, combine complementary capabilities/arrangements, attack prior-art gap and unit economics, preserve rejection reasons, then rank three candidates. Same sources/budget available.
model_identity: ChatGPT-hosted inherited GPT-6 Astra Pro agent profile; separate paid API calls not made. Exact backend snapshot, token counts and billable expenditure not exposed; no API-identifier equivalence or equal realized compute claim.

evaluation.scales: 0–5 per declared criterion; source-backed justification, human reviewer proxy only. Novelty, useful outcome, technical feasibility and commercial mechanism recorded separately.
evaluation.selection_rule: Choose highest defensible weighted score after checking prior art and running a cheap falsification probe. A candidate needs a specific unresolved gap and a new productive possibility beyond ordinary workflow substitution. Ties favor a more decisive experiment; convenient datasets alone cannot win.
evaluation.blinding: Review anonymized candidate claims without search-policy labels where practicable. Root necessarily knows prompt allocation; not a double-blind trial.
forbidden_claims: Success probability from absence in one baseline output
Performance gain inferred from a prompt alone
evaluation.human_comparison: No live human-expert search. Estimate a credible human-led discovery/construction pathway separately; do not count an LLM as a human trial.

confirmation: After selecting and developing a construction, freeze its technical and commercial policies before fresh seeded confirmation. Search findings remain exploratory; later outcomes never become initial inputs.
